title: Skill book dashboard
description:
The ASSET & Skill Book Analytics application is a dashboard designed to help teams monitor adoptions, track revenue and student goals, and analyze geographic metrics in a clean, clutter-free interface.

It provides comprehensive visibility into performance metrics across key areas:

Revenue & Student Count Summary: Tracks metrics such as the number of skill books, total skill book revenue, average revenue per skill book, total headroom, ASSET student counts, and ASSET revenue.

Consolidated School Directory: Displays a detailed directory of participating schools, including school names, school numbers, ownership, academic consultants (ACAD), and school types (e.g., Retention, New School).
usage:
To use and navigate the dashboard effectively, you can interact with the various control and navigation panels visible on the screen:
Apply Data Controls & Filters:
Use the sidebar on the left (Data Controls) to filter and segment the data according to your specific needs:
Hierarchy Filters: Filter by Team Handling and Ownership Leader.
Personnel Filters: Filter by Account Owner, Acad Consultant, and SSF Creator.
Location Filters: Filter by State / Union Territory and City.

Navigate Core Sections:
Use the top navigation bar to switch between different analytical views and tools:
School Directory: View consolidated school listings and details.
Role Performance: Analyze performance metrics broken down by roles.
Product Offerings: Inspect data related to different products.
Geospatial Maps: Analyze adoption and metrics geographically.
Updates Log: Check recent logs and updates.

Explore Metric Details:

Click on 🔽 View ASSET Details to dive deeper into specific ASSET metrics.
Use the arrows and interactive tables (such as the Consolidated School Directory table) to review individual school data and classifications.

title: Ei ASSET Talent Search · India Dashboard
description:
The Ei ASSET Talent Search · India Dashboard is an internal, confidential analytical portal designed for Educational Initiatives to track and monitor student participation, qualifiers, and registration metrics for the ASSET Talent Search program.

It provides an overview of performance across regions, featuring summary metrics such as:

Schools: Total number of participating schools with 2026 data (currently 337 schools).

2026 Qualifiers: Total number of students who qualified (31,421 students).

2026 Registered: Live registration totals (762 total, broken down across schools, non-ASSET schools, and earlier qualifiers).

2026 Conversion: The registration-to-qualifier conversion rate (2.4%).

Consolidated School Table: A detailed breakdown listing individual schools, their school codes, cities, states, 2026 qualifiers, 2026 registered counts, and conversion percentages.
usage:
To navigate and utilize the dashboard effectively:

Filter Data:

Click on the Filters section (filter_list) at the top to segment the data by parameters such as State, City, HO ATS Partner, and various Manager Levels.

Use the Clear all filters button (restart_alt) to reset your view.

Search for Specific Schools:

Use the search bar ("Search by school name, code, city or manager...") to quickly locate a specific institution or team member.

Refresh Data:

Click the Refresh button at the top right to sync and update the data with the latest records.

Export Data:

Click the Download button to export the school data table for offline reporting or analysis.

title: ASSET Talent Search Portal
description:
The Ei ASSET Talent Search Portal is a public-facing platform designed for students who took part in the Ei ASSET assessments.

The main page provides a simple and direct interface that allows students to:

Check whether they have qualified for the Ei ASSET Talent Search India '25.

Access preparatory resources and study guidelines through the How to Prepare section.
usage:
To check your qualification status on this page:

Enter Your Identifier:

Locate the input field labeled ENTER ASSET PAN (E.G. 1232436184).

Type in your unique ASSET Personal Identification Number (PAN).

Submit Your Query:

Click the Check Status button directly below the input box to view your qualification results.

Explore Preparation Materials:

Switch to the How to Prepare tab at the top of the container if you want to view guidelines and study resources for the talent search.

title: Master Data Campaign Checker
description: The Master Data Campaign Checker is an administrative utility tool for Educational Initiatives (Ei ASSET Talent Search India '25) used to cross-reference and audit target student records. It allows administrators to check specific ASSET Personal Identification Numbers (PANs) against master database records or synchronize live status data to manage campaign verification.
usage:
To perform a campaign check and verify student records, follow these steps:

Provide the Master Database:

Option A: Click the [Load Server Master File] button or [Sync Live Statuses] to fetch data directly from the server or synchronize current statuses.

Option B: Alternatively, upload a local master database file in .csv or .xlsx format using the file picker under section 1. Master Database (.csv, .xlsx).

Upload the Campaign File:

Under section 2. Upload Campaign File (.csv, .xlsx), click [Choose file] to select and upload your target file containing the specific ASSET PANs you wish to check.

title: Webinar Calendar
description: This application is the Webinar Calendar platform for Educational Initiatives (Ei). It serves as an internal and external scheduling and event hub designed to help educators, administrators, and learners discover, track, and manage webinars and professional development sessions (such as the Ei ASSET SkillBook and various misconception-mastery workshops for math, science, and social studies).
usage:
Navigating the Calendar View:

Use the Month or Week toggle buttons at the top right of the calendar header to switch between monthly and weekly layouts.

Use the arrow buttons (< and >) to navigate across different months (the default view shown is October 2026).

Filtering Events:

Use the category filters at the top right (All, Internal, or External) to narrow down the types of sessions displayed on the calendar.

Use the main navigation tabs (Calendar, Bookmarks, etc.) to switch between viewing the main schedule and your saved sessions.

Viewing and Saving Event Details:

Click on any specific event card listed on a date (e.g., Ei ASSET SkillBook – V2 or science misconception sessions) to view its full description, presenter details, and meeting links.

From the event details view, you can save the session to your personal list or bookmarks .

title: Automated Badge E-mailer
description: This application is the Automated Badge E-mailer, a tool designed to seamlessly generate and email Verifiable Credentials (open badges) to recipients with customized achievements, criteria, and branding.
usage:
Fill in Achievement Details:

Enter the Achievement Name (e.g., Python Fundamentals).

Provide an Achievement Description and specific Achievement Criteria (e.g., modules completed, passing scores).

Configure Optional Settings:

Select a Proficiency Level if applicable (options include Foundational, Intermediate, Advanced, or Mastery).

Upload a Custom Badge Image in .png format, or leave it blank to use the default badge image.

Add Recipients:

Enter your recipients in the Recipients List text box following the format Name, Email (with one recipient per line).

Send:

Click the [Send Badges via Email] button to generate and distribute the credentials.
